newsitem.title: USA: First Merchants Acceptance forms unit.
newsitem.headline: First Merchants Acceptance forms unit.

text.p: First Merchants Acceptance Corp said on Wednesday it formed First Merchants Residential Credit Corp, a new subsidiary that will originate and service residential mortgage loans.
The new unit will enter the market in the second half of 1997, providing products designed to leverage a homeowner's equity and credit qualifications, the company said.
Mitchell Kahn, president of First Merchants Acceptance, will also be president and chief executive officer of the new company.

The unit, headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas, will initially offer its products on a wholesale basis to primary lenders in various states. All processing, funding and servicing operations will be centrally located in Fort Worth.
First Merchants Acceptance is a specialty finance company, financing used automobiles for consumers who have limited access to traditional sources of credit.
